title: Virtual Intelligent Dev Team Decision Log Entry
description: Append-only governance decision log. One JSON object per line. Backward-compatible extension of the legacy governance_events.jsonl format; legacy entries are migrated by scripts/migrate_governance_events.py with defaults for the four v5.0 fields (decision, verifier, reason, evidence).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with seconds precision. Produced by datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds') in route_request.py.

decision.description: Semantic decision kind. Legacy entries default to route_selected.

lead_agent.description: Selected lead agent display string (must match agent_rules keys, e.g. 'Technical Trinity', 'Sentinel Architect (NB)').

verifier.description: Independent verification outcome. n_a means no verifier ran (typical for routing-only entries). Legacy entries default to n_a.

risk_level.description: Risk tier inferred by governance layer (or default low).

selected_track.description: Privy council track selection. 'regular track' = full dual-sign flow; 'fast track' = quota-gated expedited flow.

reason.description: Short human-readable rationale. Legacy entries default to empty string. Free-form prose, not validated.

evidence.description: Optional evidence pointer — test IDs, command outputs, gate statuses, or '||'-joined fragments. Optional; not required.

mode_hint.description: Producer tag indicating which script/branch emitted the entry (e.g. 'route_request', 'release_gate').
